# Explicit skill selection reference

`upstream-selection.json` is generated by executing original code from openai/codex
`815ef9bbc47bef3bde9cfceaaaf3ef74bb43d052` (Apache-2.0):

```sh
python3 generate_reference.py /path/to/codex
```

The generator verifies the revision and invokes `rustc` on an isolated harness containing the
original `skills/src/mentions.rs`, `ext/skills/src/selection.rs`, `skills/src/selection.rs` and
`skills/src/name_counts.rs`. Only the extension selector's tracing attribute and module import
paths are removed or redirected. The selection bodies and parser are not rewritten.

Protocol/catalog records and Host path wrappers are substituted with small local records. The Host
fixture uses absolute native paths, identity equality, no discovery aliases, and empty connector
counts; it does not establish URI conversion, Windows path identity, connector discovery, or
filesystem behavior. Separate adapter tests cover discovery aliases, connector conflicts,
home expansion, rejection of relative text-link paths and file URIs, and cwd resolution only for
structured Skill inputs. No Rusty implementation supplies expected selections.

Each of the 20 input batches runs through both selectors. Extension results compare sorted
membership because upstream traverses HashSets; Host results preserve their original discovery
order. Coverage includes structured selection priority, invalid-path fallback blocking, linked
paths, hidden/disabled skills, namespace names, environment variables, exact names, non-skill
links and Unicode surrounding the mention. The extension and core Host selectors intentionally
have different ambiguous-name behavior.
